# ChartStyle

How every chart in CLR is styled in Recharts: the live load line, replay, daily focus bars, context mix, and the best-hours heatmap.

`CLR.ChartStyle` · Data display

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.ChartStyle kind={…} ariaLabel="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.ChartStyle" kind="{{…}}" aria-label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Recharts styling recipe. Not a component: these are the props every chart passes to Recharts primitives. See components/ChartStyle/README.md.

## Props (ChartStyleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `'live-load' \| 'replay' \| 'daily-bars' \| 'context-mix' \| 'heatmap'` |  |
| `height` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | 'sm' 160px tall (mobile), 'md' 220px, 'lg' 280px. |
| `ariaLabel` * | `string` | Screen-reader summary, e.g. "Load over the last 5 minutes, now 62 percent, peak 71". |
